texts: good. Hesper is typed as a warden, Cauldron Hall comes out as a named hall, and the link between the two is recorded; the only thing not carried is the uniqueness of "the" (a one-holder office has no carrier anywhere in the instruction set, so no rewrite helps).
good. "became Warden" comes out as a past change of state with Hesper ending up a warden, and "two years ago" is recorded as a two-year gap before now.

bad: same trouble as "sits on the Council" - the denial is stored as "no sitting event on the Council" rather than "not a member", so a membership question finds nothing and it does not line up with the other lore sentences about Council seats. Rewrite as "Hesper is not a member of the Council."

mixed: the reporting event, "essence production" and the Council as recipient are all correct, but the recurrence was recorded as a once-a-month period the sentence never states (a full moon is not a calendar month); that atom was ruled a defect, and dropping it leaves "at each full moon" with no carrier at all, so the "each" is simply lost. Putting the recurrence in its own clause gives it one: "Whenever the moon is full, Hesper reports essence production to the Council."
